caption:
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick are clashing over Nvidia chip exports to China.

The dispute centers on whether the Commerce Department failed to block shipments to a firm with suspicious links. This public disagreement exposes significant friction within the current administration regarding how strictly to enforce tech trade bans. It raises questions about how the U.S. will manage sensitive technology exports moving forward.

Should the government prioritize strict trade enforcement or business interests when regulating tech exports?
